Validate a declared database

Source: R/io_data.R
validate_io.Rd

Checks the database and returns a report. Problems that make the model impossible (inconsistent dimensions, x <= 0, missing values) already stop declare_io(); this report holds the warnings and information:

Usage

validate_io(io)

Arguments

io

Object of class lexio_io.

Value

Data frame with check, level ("ok", "warning" or "info") and detail.

Details

  • column sums of A (should be below 1) and invertibility of I - A;

  • signs of A and of the account coefficients D;

  • the corridor mode (free, two-sided, floor, ceiling) and its range;

  • the balance (I - A) x against f, whatever the declaration (Z, A or B): by default f is the goal of the economic block, so a difference means that the base output x does not meet it exactly.
